# Browser Use Box

Browser Use Box is an open-source way to run a 24/7 Claude Code agent on a Linux box with Telegram control, Browser Use Cloud, and a persistent real browser.

## Primary links

- Launch page: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/
- GitHub: https://github.com/browser-use/bux
- Install guide: https://github.com/browser-use/bux/blob/main/install.md

## Managed pilot

- Managed pilot for Telegram-heavy teams: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/pilot.html
- Managed Telegram AI operator: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/telegram-ai-operator.html
- Partner pilot for AI automation agencies: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/managed-pilot-partners.html
- Pilot playbook: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/managed-pilot-playbook.html
- Demo transcript: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/managed-pilot-demo.html
- Pilot terms: https://browser-use.github.io/bux/managed-pilot-terms.html

The managed pilot is $1,000/month for one scoped private Telegram AI operator workflow, launched in 7 days, with human handoff and weekly tuning.
